{{Top|leg}}
The '''Government Assembly''' was the name of the republic governmental system on the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. Representatives from each of Clak'dor's [[City/Legends|city-states]] comprised the Government Assembly.

[[Weogar/Legends|Weogar]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] cultural center, was home to the [[Assembly House (Clak'dor VII)|Assembly House]], where the Government Assembly convened. Although Clak'dor city-states had different methods for assigning representatives to the Government Assembly, from election to hereditary appointment, all were equal in the Assembly House.
